world.label: Truck without fuel
world.summary: Sam can pull a lever that starts a 40-step loading line; when its last step is done the truck is loaded, and a loaded truck leaves if it has fuel. The truck has no fuel.

limits: Only a set lever can be pulled.

processes.rationale: A link falls once the link before it has fallen.
A loaded truck leaves the yard if it has fuel.

the truck is still in the yard
